usage: Outside collaborators with no activity should be removed.
name: Outside collaborators with no activity should be removed
description: Outside collaborators are not members of your organization or first-level group and may pose a greater security risk. Removing all access to a repo is recommended if they are not working on it.
detailedDescription: Outside collaborators are not members of your organization or first-level group. A best practice is to limit the access time and permissions they have to a repository. An outside collaborator who has access to a repo and has not made any changes for a long time should probably have their access removed. This way, a compromise of the outside collaborator’s account will limit the potential risk to your repository.

args.name: monthsSinceActivity
args.label: Months Since Activity
args.tooltip: Choose how many months since the last activity will trigger a violation.
